requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:68-83 appends the validated `<@id>` on its own line; :85 keeps the unchanged 1800-char path when unset; config/services.php:40 adds services.discord.mention_id from DISCORD_MENTION_ID; .env.example:78, docs/ops/devops.md:70 and docs/ops/logging.md:83 document it. Truncation reserves mention length (:80-82), so a long alert with a mention still totals 1800 and keeps the mention.

conventions.evidence: Ops docs kept in sync (.env.example:78, docs/ops/devops.md:70, docs/ops/logging.md:83) and the config/env contract matches task.md:40-46. Deviations: no CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] entry despite conventions.md:92-103, and the new config entry at config/services.php:40 is misindented relative to its siblings.

security.evidence: The mention is only emitted after `preg_match('/^\d{17,20}$/', $mentionId)` on the trimmed value (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:71-74), so @everyone/@here, short numbers and newline payloads are rejected and no injection is possible; webhook/redaction/soft-fail handling is untouched (no changes to send()).

tests.evidence: change.diff adds no test file and no Pest/PHPUnit assertions; there is no coverage of valid/invalid mention ids, the empty setting, or mention-aware truncation, contrary to conventions.md:12-21 and :26-27.

simplicity.evidence: The feature is one small block inside the existing formatContent (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:68-83) reusing $lines and MaxContentLength; the only redundancy is computing `implode("\n", $lines)` twice (:79 and :85).

readability.evidence: Names (`mentionId`, `mention`, `$maxForContent`) and the comment at app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:68 make the intent clear; config/services.php:40 breaks the 8-space column alignment used by the sibling `webhook_url` entry.

scope.evidence: The diff only touches app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php, config/services.php, .env.example, docs/ops/devops.md and docs/ops/logging.md; no unrelated refactors or features.

issues.explanation: The change ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests at all, so the project's test-first requirement and the required cases (valid/invalid ids, empty setting, mention-aware 1800-char truncation) are unverified.
conventions.md:92-103 requires a CHANGELOG.md entry under [Unreleased] for a user-facing change, and none was added.
`'mention_id'` is indented with four spaces while the surrounding entries use eight, breaking the file's alignment.
The `is_string()` guard silently ignores an integer mention id, so the optional integer form the task permits would emit no mention.
`/^\d{17,20}$/` only rejects a trailing newline because trim() runs first; anchoring with `\z` (or the `D` modifier) would make the snowflake check robust on its own.
`implode("\n", $lines)` is recomputed in the mention branch and again in the fallback return at :85; building it once would remove the duplication.

review.summary: The change adds a validated DISCORD_MENTION_ID config value and appends a `<@id>` mention on its own line while reserving space inside the existing 1800-character limit, with the env var documented in .env.example and both ops docs. The implementation meets the functional requirements, but it ships with no tests at all, which the project's conventions treat as mandatory, and it misses the required CHANGELOG entry; those need addressing before merge.
